subject: [PATCH v6 07/12] mm: handle PMD swap entries in non-present PMD walkers

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch updates various Linux kernel functions to handle PMD (Page Map Directory) swap entries, mirroring the behavior of PTE (Page Table Entry) equivalents. It introduces new helpers and modifies existing functions to account for swap entries in non-present PMD walkers, ensuring correct handling of swapped-out THPs (Transparent Huge Pages). The changes affect various kernel functions, including those related to memory mapping, page fault handling, and madvise operations.
